g.text: $ python ask.py ask --box ghost-club --url http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1 --model gemma-3-4b-it --system
The Ghost Club was formed at one time [3]. We resolved ourselves into it, and proceeded to collect evidence and
entered into a considerable correspondence upon the subject [3].
$ python ask.py ask --box ghost-club --url http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1 --model gemma-3-4b-it --system voices/ada.md
The Analytical Engine has no pretensions whatever to originate anything. It can do whatever we know how to order
